recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future PA decision reopens broader Patient-versus-Encounter visit wording.
issue_request: FHIR-15793 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request against the STU3 Administration module. It objected to Section 8.0.4 saying Patient described patient demographic and visit information and requested removal of the words "and visit" from that sentence.
initial_application: The requested edit was already applied by commit 34b0fcb8a22b5163968e13abc5aadc47f3bac9b1, whose patch changed source/administration-module.html from "patient demographic and visit information" to "patient demographic information" using the older GF#15793 tracker notation.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists administration-module.html as the active Administration module page, and current source/administration-module.html still contains the corrected sentence. PA 2018 Baltimore WGM minutes record the same change, Persuasive disposition, and 8-0-0 vote. Targeted community searches found no contrary later evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scoped source says the Patient resource describes patient demographic information and any updates to it, and no remaining build-scoped source occurrence of the disputed visit-information phrase was found.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent administration-module tracker discussed in the same PA minutes and later source history, but it concerned different Patient tracker wording and was not decided here.
